race.title: Equine Products National Hunt Trainers League Handicap Chase
race.verdict: EMPTY NEST remains on a handy mark and can go one place better than he did over C&D last week. Treaty Boy would make serious appeal after his recent Kelso win, though a fall earlier in the week at Sedgefield is far from ideal. Tom Creen looks best of the rest. EMPTY NEST (IRE) TREATY BOY (IRE) TOM CREEN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Treaty Boy (11/8), Empty Nest (5/1), Tom Creen (13/2), Illogical Logic (13/2), Powerofjet (7/1), The Paddy Pie (14/1), Party In The Park (20/1), Kinbara Firstdraft (20/1), Ozzy Cosmo (20/1)
